title: What my Guru spec forgot

segments.text: Here's how to reverse engineer Guru from a written spec. Claude passed all thirty-one checks, but my spec never said what a due-soon card looks like.
The full spec is free at personal software factory dot com. If you build it, tell me what broke. I'm Sam. See you tomorrow.
